description: Six of us from Baku asking: could a Mars colony survive? Our strategy game puts you in charge of a new colony. You split water, food, energy and crew, and handle crises like dust storms and failing life support. Every choice changes the colony’s future, modeled on real NASA data. Omar, Vahid and Sajjad code, Ravan designs, Sahib and Amina research. Looking for a science mind or a storyteller.
